envelope.description: Audit which RPC methods and step phases modify files

body.title: Audit which RPC methods and step phases modify files
body.summary: For every method in the handler registry (src/daemon/handler-runtime.ts) and every phase of the workflow, build, review, code-review, analyze and triage steps, trace the handler with the analyzer's call closure and a read of its body, and record whether it writes under a user repository, which param holds the repo and which params hold paths. The output is a machine-readable module (the table rows and the reviewed read-only list, one entry per method or phase with its evidence) that t2 imports, plus a short document in docs/plans stating the scope decision for the daemon-store writers (config.*, keys.*, session.*, todos.*, db.*): outside the rule, as they write under ~/.insrc and not a user repository.
acceptanceChecks: every method of the registry and every step phase has an entry marked modifying, read-only or daemon-store, each with evidence
each modifying entry names its repo param and its path params
the entries are importable by code and the scope decision for the daemon-store writers is written down for the user

tests.name: repo-call-audit.test.ts: every method of the handler registry and every step phase has an audit entry marked modifying, read-only or daemon-store
